requirements.description: CRSP monthly stock returns, prices, and shares outstanding for portfolio returns, size (ME = |prc| x shrout x 1000), pre-ranking beta estimation (24-60 monthly returns), and December t-1 / June t price requirements. Sample 1962-12 through 1990-12 (returns July 1963-December 1990; pre-ranking betas need monthly returns back to July 1958).

Point-in-time share code (shrcd 10/11 = ordinary common) and exchange code (exchcd 1/2/3 = NYSE/AMEX/NASDAQ) validity windows for the CRSP universe filter, plus SIC code for the financial-firm exclusion (paper excludes financials; funda has no SIC column, so CRSP's point-in-time siccd is used).

Monthly delisting returns and codes so equal-weighted portfolio returns incorporate delisting distributions (paper uses CRSP return files without discussing delisting separately; standard CRSP holding returns include dlret).

Market proxy for post-ranking beta estimation: CRSP value-weighted return of NYSE, AMEX, and (after 1972) NASDAQ stocks, July 1963-December 1990 (330 months). msi.vwretd is exactly this index (NYSE from 1925, AMEX from 1962, NASDAQ from 1972).
Point-in-time CRSP-Compustat link (permno <-> gvkey) for merging Compustat accounting data onto CRSP securities. Standard filter linktype IN ('LC','LU'), linkprim IN ('P','C'), usedflag = 1.

Compustat annual industrial fundamentals for fiscal years 1962-1989: total assets (A = at), book equity (BE = ceq + txdb; item 60 = ceq per paper), earnings (E = ib + txdi - dvp), plus stockholders' equity (seq) and preferred (pstk, pstkrv) for fallbacks and the FF filter flags. NOTE: sample is 1962-1989, so a datafmt='STD' filter (which drops pre-1987 'HIST' rows) must NOT be applied blindly; use indfmt='INDL', consol='C', popsrc='D' and inspect datafmt coverage for 1962-1989.

notes: All six data requirements are fully covered by crsp_202601 (msf, dsenames, msedelist, msi, ccmxpf_linktable) and comp_202601 (funda). No Fama-French factor tables are needed — the paper uses no factor models; the only factor-like input is the CRSP VW market index (msi) for beta estimation, and the Table VI NYSE VW/EW benchmark series are computed from CRSP NYSE-listed stocks directly. Daily CRSP data (dsf) are not required: both pre-ranking and post-ranking betas use monthly returns. The financial-firm exclusion uses CRSP siccd (funda carries no SIC in this vintage).
